findings.note: iOS deal(seed:) doesn't invalidate a running demo. playChallenge + the Deal-alert Play call deal() directly (toolbar is live during a demo); a queued demoStep then runs applyDemoToken on the new board -> removeLast on empty column traps / out-of-range, or corrupts + strands demoing=true (input locked, demoBar stuck). Fix: make deal(seed:) itself call stopDemo().

findings.region: index.html deal(); keydown 'n'; seed modal goDeal/dealRandom; winsPlay
findings.note: Web deal() never clears demoing/demoTimer; the 'n' key, seed modal, and wins-play call deal() without stopDemo(). A pending setTimeout step then fires with demoing true -> applyDemoToken hits pop()===undefined -> TypeError thrown before rescheduling and before demoing cleared -> loop dies with demoing stuck true -> startDrag locked forever. Fix: call stopDemo() inside deal().

applyDemoToken mutates the live board; backgrounding mid-demo runs the normal persist hooks (web saveGame guard isWon() is false mid-demo; iOS persist()). A half-auto-played casual board is saved and resumed on next launch. Fix: skip persistence while demoing (web saveGame add demoing to the guard; iOS persist() guard on !demoing).
